title: Hierarchical Task Network planning in the Goal Lifecycle
abstract: arXiv:2610.34668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Goal reasoning (GR) is the process by which intelligent agents continually reason about the goals they are pursuing, which may lead to goal change, for instance when opportunities arise, or when events cause discrepancies among expected and actual outcomes of actions planned to achieve goals. In this paper we investigate whether Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planning can provide a uniform implementation of the Goal Lifecycle, a flexible process model for goal reasoning in dynamic environments. The Goal Lifecycle progressively refines goals by adding constraints to them through a series of strategies (e.g., {\it formulate, select, expand}) and uses other strategies (e.g., {\it defer, re-expand, repair}) to resolve the current goal when an event impacts it. translated_title: 目标生命周期中的分层任务网络规划
translated_abstract: 目标推理（GR）是智能体持续对其所追求的目标进行推理的过程，这一过程可能导致目标发生改变，例如当机会出现时，或者当事件导致为达成目标而规划的行动的预期结果与实际结果之间出现差异时。在本文中，我们研究了分层任务网络（HTN）规划是否能够为目标生命周期提供一种统一的实现，目标生命周期是一种用于动态环境中目标推理的灵活过程模型。目标生命周期通过一系列策略（如“制定”formulate、“选择”select、“扩展”expand）为目标添加约束，从而逐步细化目标；当事件影响当前目标时，则使用其他策略（如“推迟”defer、“重新扩展”re-expand、“修复”repair）来处理当前目标。我们提出了一种新颖的目标推理智能体架构，该架构在目标生命周期中采用HTN规划。除了在“扩展”和“重新扩展”策略中使用HTN规划之外，（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的目标推理智能体架构，将分层任务网络（HTN）规划统一应用于目标生命周期的各项策略中，为动态环境下的目标推理提供了灵活且一致的过程模型实现。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a novel goal reasoning agent architecture that employs Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planning as a uniform implementation of the Goal Lifecycle, providing a flexible process model for goal reasoning in dynamic environments.
